verdict.rationale: Kushki is a payments platform, so controlling data retention and deletion is a fair privacy question for this kind of product. The evidence pack covers card payments, refunds, 3DS, network tokens, subscriptions and docs probes, but nothing documents retention settings, data deletion or erasure requests. Voids and refunds reverse transactions; they are an adjacent feature, not data deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
